message: リ・クリエの夜に

name: Melilot
message: 「The shooting stars continue to fall endlessly... It won't be long now, will it?」

name: Helena
message: 「It comes down to whether things are settled before the Holy Night Festival」

name: Melilot
message: 「Do they truly intend to accomplish this with the Crusaders alone?」

name: Helena
message: 「Of course they do」

name: Melilot
message: 「How frustrating... to not be able to do anything」

name: Helena
message: 「What are you talking about? Watching over everyone is our role, after all」

name: Helena
message: 「Those kids intend to welcome Azel-chan as a friend」

name: Helena
message: 「That's why adults don't butt into children's quarrels」

name: Melilot
message: 「You realize this could divide the world itself?」

name: Helena
message: 「And you've been teaching them all this time so they could stand up to it, haven't you?」

name: Helena
message: 「I trust you. So I trust in the strength of your students, the Crusaders, too」

name: Helena
message: 「Now then, since we were invited and all, I'd better get ready for the Holy Night Festival」

name: Melilot
message: 「*Sigh*... Are you already talking about what happens after they win?」

name: Helena
message: 「Naturally♪ They're bound to win, aren't they?」

name: Helena
message: 「After all, he's our Demon Lord!」

name: Azel
message: 「...So you came after all」

name: Synn
message: 「Right back at you. You really can't bring yourself to back down either, huh」

name: Azel
message: 「Of course not. I was sent here to carry out my master's will」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that what you believe in...?」

name: Azel
message: 「What are you trying to say?」

name: Ria
message: 「Where is your own will in all of this, Azel-san?」

name: Azel
message: 「My own will... you say?」

name: Synn
message: 「Literally, your own feelings. Do they truly wish for the regeneration of the world?」

name: Azel
message: 「Are you suggesting that I am being manipulated?」

name: Synn
message: 「Even if that fate was imposed upon you, haven't your own convictions already been twisted in order to fulfill that mission?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn might be the Demon Lord. But before that, he's just a single boy named Synn Sakura」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Together with the President, we have overcome harsh and grueling trials」

name: Misa
message: 「And because we did it of our own free will, our efforts were able to bear fruit. Isn't that right, Sakura-kun」

name: Ria
message: 「The strength we nurtured this way... With this power spun from the bonds of us, the Crusaders--」

name: Synn
message: 「We will stand against the presence of Re-Crea hiding in your shadow」

name: Azel
message: 「I possessed the Spirit Power capable of wielding Re-Crea at will」

name: Azel
message: 「I volunteered for the regeneration of the world, and I was chosen」

name: Azel
message: 「Otherwise, Re-Crea would never have chosen me as its vessel」

name: Synn
message: 「My fate as the Demon Lord isn't something I carved out for myself. It was decided from the moment I was born」

name: Azel
message: 「I carved out my path by my own will」

name: Synn
message: 「Right. That's why I believe you can change」

name: Azel
message: 「Change... me?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「She means changing Azel isn't a hopeless cause」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If only we had realized this sooner, we wouldn't have had to make an enemy of Azel-san」

name: Misa
message: 「Melilot-san always used to say that as long as the odds aren't zero, there's always plenty of hope to turn them into a hundred」

name: Ria
message: 「That's why we won't give up. We will... change Azel-san's convictions!!」

name: Azel
message: 「Absurd! As if you could so easily... shatter this power--this will of mine!」

name: Synn
message: 「...I get it. You have things you refuse to yield on too, don't you, Azel」

name: Synn
message: 「Then we'll fight as well. For the things we refuse to yield on!!」
